name: Waggle Dispatch
description: Recruit scouts by sun-relative dance direction and held duration.
natural_language: Recruit six scouts to the named site and none to the other sites. Up on the comb means toward the sun at release; hold time means distance. Returning scouts report your dance. Recall the last scout to correct a mistake.

metadata.notes: Original sun-relative continuous dance and delayed scout recruitment. Script evidence is not human or agent calibration.
